status_label: Account creation open: current-cycle loan window not yet announced
note: NELFUND account creation is currently open and has no announced deadline, so you can create your account and sort out your BVN. The current academic cycle loan and upkeep window should be treated as unconfirmed until NELFUND announces official opening and closing dates. Always confirm on portal.nelf.gov.ng. Do not rely on social media for deadlines. The home card cycle year updates automatically from the academic calendar (from August each year).
